summary: Backend v3 API endpoints tested post-refactoring (Phase 3). All 114 tests passed - no regressions after extracting OddsSyncService, PicksGetterService, StatsEnrichmentService, and DataIntegrityService from demon_goblin_engine.py. Engine reduced from 8,252 to 2,705 lines (~67% reduction).

GET /api/v3/status.details: Returns sync status with correct counts (unique_players=86, total_props=3851, standard/demons/goblins breakdown)

GET /api/v3/war-zone.details: Returns 10 demon picks with 4-Pillar scoring, heat_level (0-5), DVP info - delegated to PicksGetterService

GET /api/v3/goblin-vault.details: Returns 10 safe goblin picks with vault_score, safety_level (1-5) - delegated to PicksGetterService

GET /api/v3/front-lines.details: Returns 10 mixed tier picks with bullet_level (1-6), demon/goblin counts - delegated to PicksGetterService

GET /api/v3/parlay-builder.details: Returns 5 parlay types (2-6 picks) with payout info, combined probability, 2-Team Rule compliance

GET /api/v3/board.details: Returns full board with 86 players and all props data

cross_service_consistency.details: Status counts match tier endpoint data, tier endpoints share sync time

service_delegation.details: PicksGetterService handles all tier endpoints, ParlayBuilderService handles parlay generation

data_integrity.details: Player names valid, stat_types valid, hit_rates in range [0-100], lines positive

new_services_created_phase3: OddsSyncService (244 lines) - Main sync orchestration, fetches odds and stores to MongoDB
PicksGetterService (408 lines) - Tier data fetching (War Zone, Goblin Vault, Front Lines, Parlay Builder)
StatsEnrichmentService (467 lines) - Stats enrichment from BDL/Tank01/NBA.com with caching
DataIntegrityService (181 lines) - Data verification, NAJI safeguard, verification failure logging

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 new Phase 3 services are working correctly through proxy delegation
PicksGetterService correctly handles all tier endpoint data fetching with AI insights injection
OddsSyncService orchestrates the full sync flow with proper normalization and deduplication
StatsEnrichmentService provides multi-source fallback (BDL -> Tank01 -> NBA.com) for stats
DataIntegrityService implements NAJI safeguard for player ID verification
Engine reduced by 67% (8,252 -> 2,705 lines) while maintaining full functionality
test_credentials: None required - APIs use in-memory cache
seed_data_creation: N/A - uses existing synced data from MongoDB
